# Seeds whose SELF-HOST arm64 result through the SEMANTIC lowering
# (FERN_SEM_IR=1) disagrees with the interpreter's, for
# TestDifferential_SelfHostSemanticArm64
# (internal/e2e/diff_oracle_selfhost_arm64_leg_test.go).
#
# Format: <seed> <reason + issue>. Blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
# Same contract as the three files beside it: a row is a known bug being
# tolerated so the rest of the corpus keeps running, and the leg fails on a new
# divergence and on a listed seed that starts agreeing.
#
# Which file a seed belongs in is decided by the two axes the four legs cover.
# One that diverges here and agrees on the arm64 AST leg is the semantic
# lowering's, or the mixed module's, on this target; one that diverges on both
# arm64 legs belongs in selfhost-diff-arm64-known-divergences.txt; one that
# diverges on the semantic leg of both targets belongs in
# selfhost-diff-semantic-x86_64-known-divergences.txt as well, and is the
# lowering rather than either backend.
